QuestInfo.name: Don Hwang's Request
QuestInfo.0: You hear that Nella at Kerning City is the one to talk to if you're looking for work...
QuestInfo.1: You give Nella 1000 mesos as commission for telling you about various requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is to get materials for Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop. You must find #b5 #t4000042#s#k and #b5 #t4000035#s#k that Wraiths are known to drop. It won't be too hard, since you can easily find Stirges and Jr. Wraiths at the Subway.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered what Don Hwang asked for and you got bunch of lemons in return. You wonder what kind of armor Don Hwang will make. Nella said there are many more requests you can do. You should visit Nella every once in a while.

0.0: Whoa, I haven't seen you before! I'm guessing you're not from here. My name's #b#p1052103##k, and I know everything that goes on around town. That's right, I'm always the first with any juicy piece of news!
0.1: For #b1000 mesos#k, I can gather some intel and hook you up with work. You game? Think of me as your agent! I get a cut, but you get a gig.

yes.0: Awesome! Like I promised, you give me 1000 mesos, I give you the hook-ups. I'm so efficient, I have your first job right here. #b#p1051001##k from the armor store has been collecting rare items for a new piece of armor he's trying to create.
yes.1: It shouldn't be tough for you to get me #b5 #t4000042#s#k and #b5 #t4000035#s#k, right? Once you get me the goods, I'll slide you your reward. Now get to work!

no.0: Hey, it's your call. You change your mind, you give me a call.

1.0: Got the goods? Excellent! Here's your reward. #b#p1051001##k has provided a bunch of #b#t2010004#s#k as payment. Use them well!

yes.0: Alright, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p1051001##k requested. You need to gather #b5 #t4000042#s#k and #b5 #t4000035#s#k to help with the new piece of armor. Just bring everything to me. Good luck!
